claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_trigger in ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sneak Attack fires once per turn when the rogue hits with a qualifying weapon attack. The on_hit_trigger family exists for MasteryMechanics but is excluded from ClassFeatureMechanics. No honest PassiveMechanics or ActivatedAbilityMechanics encoding exists for a per-hit conditional damage rider.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: MasteryEffect / class_feature effect: extra_weapon_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Sneak Attack rider adds Nd6 extra damage of the weapon's type to the hit target. MasteryEffect has grant_weapon_attack (nested attack on secondary target), modify_roll_advantage (disadvantage rider), and save_gate — none of which express 'add extra damage of weapon's type to the current attack's target'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll … The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DamageTypeRef: weapon_damage_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Sneak Attack damage type equals the weapon's own damage type at resolution time. DamageTypeRef accepts a fixed DamageType or a cast-time choice over DamageType values — neither models 'inherit weapon's type'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: WeaponProperty: finesse
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sneak Attack requires the attack to use a Finesse or Ranged weapon. WeaponProperty only has 'thrown'; 'finesse' is absent. WeaponFilter.weapon_category covers 'ranged' but there is no property-level 'finesse' variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OnHitPredicate: disjunctive (advantage + weapon_filter) OR (ally_within_5ft + no_disadvantage)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger condition is a two-branch disjunction: primary branch requires Advantage + Finesse/Ranged weapon; secondary branch replaces Advantage with an ally-within-5ft check (ally not Incapacitated, attacker not at Disadvantage). No predicate grammar in OngoingPredicate or anywhere in the current surface models ally-proximity checks or disjunctive trigger conditions.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You don't need Advantage on the attack roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target, the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, and you don't have Disadvantage on the attack roll.
